speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I see you have knee pain after increasing your physical activity; to help me understand your condition, how long has this pain been present and on which side of the knee is it located? Also, does the pain worsen with activity or is it present at rest?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient presents with knee pain that started yesterday and has been steadily worsening. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Given the history of pivoting and twisting in volleyball, have you noticed any specific sounds like a "pop" or any swelling in the knee since the pain began? Also, is there any instability or "giving way" sensation when you try to move?
